newsitem.title: JAPAN: Japan MOF tells Yasuda Trust to beef up management.
newsitem.headline: Japan MOF tells Yasuda Trust to beef up management.

text.p: Japan's Ministry of Finance instructed Yasuda Trust & Banking Co Ltd on Friday to strengthen internal management of its overseas operations, the MOF said in a statement.

The instruction was given out after the ministry looked into the foreign bond transactions at the bank's Hong Kong unit, which violated Yasuda's internal rules although they did not break Hong Kong laws, a MOF official said.
The incident became public in April.
"We instructed Yasuda Trust to strengthen its internal management system and asked them to submit a plan by the end of this year to the ministry on how to carry this out," he said.

Yasuda Trust Asia Pacific Ltd, a Hong Kong unit of Yasuda Trust, posted losses of 20 million yen from unauthorised foreign bond transactions from February to March, but they were not properly reported to the bank's headquarters.
Yasuda Trust said in a statement that it has been implementing steps to beef up its internal management system at the Hong Kong unit since April.
"We will take these instructions seriously and will make efforts to thoroughly strengthen our internal management system," it said.
